lede: Wat Phra Bat Ming Mueang accounts for 27 catalogued manuscripts, 1 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phrae (96% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Mueang District. Nearly all (96%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1783–1961 CE (20 of 27 carry a date).
